needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m obstructed with trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built sidewalk of at least 1m width along the left side of the street.

needed.evidence: Informal path obstructed by parked vehicles or street goods

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at pedestrian crossing
